invariant_forms_bosonic_W0.notation:
Engine A: index-free (invariant) form of the bosonic W_0 kernels.  For pair types and words whose letters and outputs
are all bosonic with vector indices (AV, AsV: SO(4) index m; AW, AsW: SO(6) index I; c, cs: none), every table entry
polynomial is fitted exactly onto the basis of O(4) x O(6) invariant structures (Kronecker deltas among the slots,
slots contracted with output momenta r_j, scalar products r_i.r_j) and the fit is verified on every entry.  Structures
are printed as d(x,y) (delta), x.rj, rj.rk with slots a, b (letters) and o1, o2, ... (outputs in chain order).

closed_forms.k=0 (Lemma lem:tl-k0, all W): K^(0)(d^al phi_a, d^be phi_b) = hbar Phat-numerator (-1)^{|be|} (d^{al+be} S_eps)(0), (d^gam S_eps)(0) = (-1)^{m+1}/(16 pi^2 m 2^{m-1} eps^m) sum_{pairings} prod delta, |gam| = 2(m-1); single power, no log. Verified (gate G6) for (A,A) and (c,A*_V) with up to 5 derivatives.
closed_forms.k=1, constant chain numerator N_V (quart: 16 pi^2 [log] = -N_V sum_{a,b,j} (i(s,R))^a (i(u,R))^b |u-s|^{2j} (|R|^2/4)^j (a+j)!(b+j)!/(a! b! (j!)^2 (a+b+2j+1)!), point splitting X_a(x+s) X_b(x+u), R = total output momentum; N_V = minus the W_0 log value of the bubble.

[log]K = -(1/16 pi^2) e^{i(s,R)} int_Delta N_V(i d_sigma)[e^{-i(sigma,c)} (-1)^E sum_m (|sigma|^2/4)^{m+E-2} Phi^m/(m!(m+E-2)!)] (engine variables: edges k+q_i, c = -sum alpha_i q_i, sigma = u-s); eps^{-m}: (1/m) sum_e int_{R_e} alpha_e^m with Bessel order m+E-2.
